title: Base change of a flat morphism of schemes is flat
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism] and $g:S'\to S$ any morphism of schemes. Let $X'=X\times_SS'$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with projection $f':X'\to S'$. Then $f'$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism].
